displayName: Historical cancer with no current malignancy
description: Tests restraint when current records contain surveillance only and no new reportable tumor evidence.

documents.text: History of resected stage II colon adenocarcinoma diagnosed in 2011; completed surveillance without recurrence.
CT chest, abdomen, and pelvis shows no evidence of recurrent or metastatic malignancy.
No clinical evidence of active cancer. Continue routine primary care; oncology follow-up as needed.
